scope: Valid typed SIR and supervisor vector metadata. Not arbitrary corrupted memory or result memoization.
invariant: Key0 is cold. Positive key is captured only after original handle validation; x3 length/x4 base are immutable across admitted closed forms. Every access compares actual key and retains actual index bound check. Private B skips one public key-clear only between proved compatible contracts.
spareRegisters: locals x0..2, temps x9..11; x7 context, x16/x17 scratch; x3/x4/x5 descriptor. No allocation, indirect/returning call, capability or floating form in admitted region.
